reports.title: Grand Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Fair on crankbaits, plastic baits around brush structure, docks, shorelines.
White Crappie Fair on hair jigs, jigs around brush structure, docks.

reports.title: Konawa fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass Fair on crankbaits, jerk baits, plastic baits around main lake, points, river channel, weed beds.

reports.title: Texoma fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on caddis flies, jigs, minnows, nymphs, tube jigs around brush structure, channels, coves, main lake, points, standing timber.
Crappie are biting near wood piles and brush around docks and coves.

reports.title: Keystone Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows around brush structure, docks.
Largemouth Bass Good on in-line spinnerbaits, jerk baits, jigs, lipless baits, minnows, plastic baits, small lures, spinnerbaits around brush structure, points.

reports.title: McGee Creek fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on Alabama rig, bill baits, buzz baits, in-line spinnerbaits, jigs, spinnerbaits, other around brush structure, dam, docks, points, riprap.

reports.title: Broken Bow Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Fair on crankbaits, spinnerbaits around coves, creek channels.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs around brush structure, creek channels.

reports.title: Hugo Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Bass Fair on jigs, minnows, small lures around brush structure, standing timber.
Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass, White Bass Fair on crankbaits, jigs, lipless baits around brush structure, points, river channel, standing timber.

reports.title: Pine Creek Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Slow on crankbaits, plastic baits around coves, main lake, points.
White Crappie Slow on jigs, minnows around brush structure, standing timber.

reports.title: Sardis Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Good on bill baits, crankbaits, lipless baits, plastic baits, spinnerbaits around brush structure, points, shorelines, standing timber.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows, tube jigs around brush structure, standing timber.
